sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and for the State.
2. This is an application for bail U/s. 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences under Sections 420/294/506/120-B of IPC.
3. The allegations primarily relates to the non-refund of money taken by the Petitioner from the Informant on different dates under different pretext.

4. Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, nature of allegations, the circumstances appearing and the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail in connection Kharvelnagar P.S Case No. 347 of 2022 corresponding to 1CC Case No.
4600 of 2022 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., // 2 // Bhubaneswar within a period of three weeks hence, she shall be admitted to bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court, but subject to cash deposit of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only)
in the manner to be directed by the court to its satisfaction with further conditions as follows:-
(i) The Petitioner shall appear before the I.O. and cooperate with the investigation as and when required;
(ii) she shall also appear before the trial court on each date of trial, without fail, till conclusion of the trial;

(iv) she shall not indulge in any other crime of similar nature or otherwise to the present case, in any manner whatsoever, while on bail and (v) violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
5. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
